query: is yellowjackets season 4 the last season
title: Is Yellowjackets season 4 the last season? Yes, it's the final one
answer: Yes. Season 4 is the final season of Yellowjackets. It premieres Friday, Nov. 20, 2026, on Paramount+, with new episodes reported to arrive weekly on Fridays through the finale on Jan. 22, 2027.
body:
The ending was announced in October 2025, months after Showtime renewed the series for a fourth season in May 2025. The season is billed as "The Final Reckoning." Creators Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson had originally talked about a five-season plan, but chose to wrap the story up in four.

The season has 10 episodes, according to The Week. If the weekly Friday schedule holds, the dates run Nov. 20 and 27, Dec. 4, 11, 18 and 25, and Jan. 1, 8, 15 and 22. The show streams on the Paramount+ Premium plan, so the cheaper plan may not include it.

The story picks up both timelines. In the 1990s, the girls' soccer team is found after 19 months in the wilderness, and rescue does not end their troubles. In the present day, the adult survivors face old secrets resurfacing. Returning stars include Melanie Lynskey, Christina Ricci, Tawny Cypress and Sophie Nélisse. Hilary Swank joins as adult Melissa, and Molly Ringwald and June Squibb are among the new cast members.
in_the_news: The final season of Yellowjackets premieres on Paramount+ on Nov. 20, 2026.

faq.q: When does Yellowjackets season 4 come out?
How many episodes are in Yellowjackets season 4?
faq.a: Ten, according to The Week, released weekly, with the finale on Jan. 22, 2027.
The creators decided to finish the story in four seasons instead of the five they once discussed. The Week also points to falling viewership and budget pressure at Paramount.

faq.q: Is Yellowjackets based on a true story?
faq.a: No. It is fiction about a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness after a 1996 plane crash, told in two timelines: the 1990s and 25 years later.
